silicon_melting_1.name: Melting of Silicon - Level 1
silicon_melting_1.description: Simulate the melting of Silicon by heating under NPT conditions using the Stillinger–Weber (SW) potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the system by 3 times in each direction. Monitor the Si–Si bond length using the partial radial distribution function (RDF) throughout the heating. Identify the phase transition where the first RDF peak shows a significant increase, defined as more than 10% compared to the initial value. Report the average Si–Si bond length in the molten state in Å.
